title: Problem Overview
content: Erdős Problem #154: Sidon Set Sumset Distribution. Status: PROVED (Lindström 1998, Kolountzakis 1999)

title: Issidon
content: A Sidon set (B₂ set): all pairwise sums are distinct. ∀ a b c d : ℕ, a ∈ A → b ∈ A → c ∈ A → d ∈ A → a + b = c + d → ({a, b} : Finset ℕ) = {c, d}

title: Iswelldistributed
content: A set S is well-distributed mod m if each residue class contains approximately |S|/m elements. ∀ r : Fin m, |((S.filter (fun x => x % m = r)).card : ℝ) - (S.card : ℝ) / m| ≤ ε * S.card

title: Lindstrom Sidon Distribution
content: **Lindström (1998)**: A Sidon set A ⊂ {1,...,N} with |A| ~ √N is itself well-distributed modulo small numbers. (hA : IsSidon A) (hN : A ⊆ Finset.range (N + 1)) : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 2 → ∀ ε : ℝ, ε > 0 → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, N ≥ N₀ → IsWellDistributed A m ε

title: Sumset Distribution
content: **Sumset Distribution**: The Sidon property ensures A+A is also well-distributed. title: Even Odd Balance
content: **Even-Odd Case**: About half of A+A is even and half is odd. This is the specific case m = 2. (hA : IsSidon A) (hN : A ⊆ Finset.range (N + 1)) : ∀ ε : ℝ, ε > 0 → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, N ≥ N₀ → IsWellDistributed (sumset A) 2 ε

title: Erdos 154
content: Sidon sets and their sumsets are well-distributed over all small moduli. In particular, about half of A+A is even and half is odd. (hA : IsSidon A) (hN : A ⊆ Finset.range (N + 1)) : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 2 → ∀ ε : ℝ, ε > 0 → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, N ≥ N₀ → IsWellDistributed (sumset A) m ε := sumset_distribution A N hA hN
